summary: Iteration 18 is a pure frontend refactor — the six curated guide screens now use a single reusable component FoodGuideLayout. Verified full regression on mobile viewport (390x844). Login → Disclaimer → Home dashboard works; all 6 home cards (home-menu-fruits/beverages/vegetables/snacks/proteins/grains) route to the correct screens. On each of /fruits, /beverages, /vegetables, /snacks, /proteins, /grains the three tier sections render with the correct testID prefixes (fruit-, beverage-, vegetable-, snack-, protein-, grain-) and the back button (fruits-back … grains-back) is visible and returns to Home. Row testIDs follow `${prefix}-row-${slug}` correctly (verified: protein-row-grilled-baked-chicken-breast, protein-row-toor-dal-arhar, fruit-row-apple, beverage-row-water). Row taps for linked_food_id navigate: Apple → /food/food-apple; Toor Dal (arhar) → /food/food-toor-dal. Beverages screen shows blue-tinted intro card (aiBlue theme) with water icon, and fluid_ml chips are visible on every row (Water 200 ml, Buttermilk 150 ml, Herbal Tea 150 ml). All 5 non-beverage screens render with green brand-tinted intro card and no fluid chip. No red screens, no console errors.
test_report_links: Playwright script executed inline via mcp_browser_automation (no persistent .py file — pure UI regression sweep)
critical_code_review_comments: FoodGuideLayout.tsx (~350 lines) is well-scoped and healthy; no split needed. Nice consolidation removing ~90% duplication across the six guide files.
The six screen wrappers are now ~15 lines each — perfect thin-wrapper pattern.
slug() strips leading/trailing hyphens correctly, so parenthesised names like 'Toor Dal (arhar)' → 'toor-dal-arhar' work as expected (verified in DOM).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 refactor is clean. Note the testID naming: prefix is singular per screen (fruit/beverage/vegetable/snack/protein/grain) while back-button prefix is plural (fruits-back/beverages-back/...). The vegetable-section-* rename (from earlier veg-section-*) is now live and correct. Slugs strip trailing hyphens so 'Toor Dal (arhar)' becomes 'toor-dal-arhar' (not 'toor-dal-arhar-').
